inputs.commit_message: publish verified ASOL stage 2 tree to repair branch only
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
branch=agent-request/chatgpt
verified=826946fc
request=.agent-control/requests/asol-stage2-publish-20260901-0852.json
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/asol-stage2-publish-XXXXXX)
askpass=$(mktemp /tmp/asol-askpass-XXXXXX)
cleanup() { git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -rf "$tmp"; rm -f "$askpass"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$verified^{commit}"
git -C "$root" fetch origin "$branch"
remote_sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse "origin/$branch")
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$tmp" "$remote_sha"
cd "$tmp"
git config user.name gova-local-agent
git config user.email gova-local-agent@users.noreply.github.com
git cherry-pick "$verified"
rm -f "$request"
git add -u
git commit --amend --no-edit
git diff --exit-code "$verified^{tree}" HEAD^{tree}
token=$(cd "$root" && npx tsx -e "import { resolveGithubToken } from './packages/local-agent-core/src/github-api.ts'; const t=resolveGithubToken(); if(!t) process.exit(2); process.stdout.write(t)")
cat > "$askpass" <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
  *Username*) printf '%s' x-access-token ;;
  *) printf '%s' "$GIT_PUSH_TOKEN" ;;
esac
SH
chmod 700 "$askpass"
GIT_PUSH_TOKEN="$token" GIT_ASKPASS="$askpass" GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push https://github.com/printcode1000-lgtm/gova.git HEAD:refs/heads/agent-request/chatgpt
unset token GIT_PUSH_TOKEN
echo ASOL_STAGE2_PUBLISHED=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
